answer: The marble register is checked at draw time, relic lists the eligible set, and kernel seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 17 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
